_comment: ConnectionStrings:PetroVisorDb is intentionally empty here. Locally use 'dotnet user-secrets set ConnectionStrings:PetroVisorDb "..."'. In Azure, source it from Key Vault via Managed Identity — never commit a real connection string or credential to this file.
_seedingComment: Seeding:Enabled gates demo data seeding on startup (idempotent, safe to leave on). Defaults false here so Production never reseeds by accident. Override via env var SEED_DEMO_DATA=true (mapped below) or Seeding__Enabled=true.
